Param/Value/lib_1_2308333C=<s val="SF_TextGamebarBodyHighlight"><c val="FFFF00">Starting Hero</c></s><n/>Use the starting hero to push out of the base, and purchase upgrades as you get more minerals. The starting hero also has unique upgrades only available to it. Losing your hero has no mineral penalty, but you may revive your hero instantly for a mineral cost.<n/><n/><s val="SF_TextGamebarBodyHighlight"><c val="FFFF00">Armies</c></s><n/>The game offers many choices with how you may wish to progress. You can use your starting hero only, purchase supporting units to heal and/or attack, purchase an expensive hero, or upgrade a regular unit to an Elite unit using the Veterancy buff. Note that purchased heroes do not automatically revive, and must be purchased again.<n/><n/><s val="SF_TextGamebarBodyHighlight"><c val="FFFF00">Buffs</c></s><n/>When you finish all associated upgrades for your hero/unit, it's time to start buffing for additional power. You may either use the Classified Enhancements shop (control group 0) located at the farthest bottom left corner, or you may use Ctrl+C to open a menu to buff all your units at once. This menu is generally faster to use and also allows you to apply rewards on your units.<n/><n/><s val="SF_TextGamebarBodyHighlight"><c val="FFFF00">Enemies</c></s><n/>Be wary of enemy attack waves. Timed normal attack waves start at 5 minutes and boss waves start at 10 minutes, each with an increment of 10 minutes between following waves. After defeating Maar, Nydus Worms will begin to spawn, and if left unchecked can summon very powerful bosses. Enemy drop pods will spawn on top of your units, and will progressively get harder as the game progresses. The following enemy types will also penetrate armor: Ravagers/Vile Ravagers, Hunter Killers/Blood Hunters, Devilish Arthropods, Overlord/Ignoble Overlord/Dominators, Overseer/Mini Spotters, Hybrid Nemisis and Lurkers.<n/><n/><s val="SF_TextGamebarBodyHighlight"><c val="FFFF00">Upgrades</c></s><n/>Be sure to get all upgrades for your units and heroes. There are additional upgrades for each unit that can be found in their respective submenus. For example, Marine upgrades can be found under the same menu through which they were purchased: Terran Infantry Units > Terran Infantry Unit Upgrades. There are also upgrades available to only your starting hero found in the main menu (Hero Upgrades).<n/><n/><s val="SF_TextGamebarBodyHighlight"><c val="FFFF00">Banks</c></s><n/>If your bank is somehow lost, you can visit this site to recover a functional version: <c val="0080FF">https://rankings.icebanelingescape.com/bank</c>. For more information, visit the game Discord community.

The contents of the wave depends on game progress.<n/><n/><s val="SF_TextGamebarBodyHighlight"><c val="FFFF00">Nydus Worms</c></s><n/>Nydus Worms will spawn every 180 game seconds. There are 12 possible spawn locations, and Nydus Worms will despawn after a random duration depending on game difficulty. The contents of the waves depends on game progress, and Nydus enemies get progressively stronger each second the Nydus Worm is alive. Nydus Worms will spawn a Brutalisk after 80 seconds.<n/><n/><s val="SF_TextGamebarBodyHighlight"><c val="FFFF00">Timed Attacks</c></s><n/>Timed attacks spawn at the Hive location and make their way to the base. Waves that contain normal units will spawn every 10 minutes starting at the 5 minute mark. These enemies get buffs that slightly increase damage and life. Waves that contain a boss will also spawn every 10 minutes starting at the 10 minute mark. All enemies but the boss in this wave will get the same buff the standard waves get. The last regular wave will happen after 65 minutes, and the last boss wave after 70 minutes.
